mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 5.0% indicates sustained monetary accommodation, reducing the discount rate for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns through lower cost of capital.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate decline below 4.5% over 3 months signals labor market strength, increasing consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential housing starts (HOUST > 1400) and consumer spending (RSAFS > 370000) indicates robust demand conditions, expanding corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 60-day returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1400 and RSAFS > 370000.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 110 (INDPRO > 110) signals manufacturing expansion, increasing output and corporate profits, which drives positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 110.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% indicates monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth exceeding 2.5% annually (GDPC1 growth rate > 2.5%) in late-cycle expansion regimes signals sustained economic momentum, supporting positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment growth (PAYEMS > 138000) and unemployment decline (UNRATE < 4.7) indicate labor market tightening, boosting consumer confidence and driving positive S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 138000 and UNRATE < 4.7.

mechanism_narrative: Residential housing starts above 1400 thousand units (HOUST > 1400) indicate strong consumer demand for housing, expanding sectoral output and generating positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1400.
